purpose: Replace only component 577 after native 200x200 review found the previous happy mouth visually crooked. The new source must be a centered, symmetric, compact V9-native happy mouth.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole visual reference for V9 eye identity, highlights, brows, cheeks, nose, normal-mouth anchor, scale and ink weight

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the sole image input. All V42 generated art is inactive evidence and is not an image-generation input.
identity_locks: Keep the exact V9 open-eye bodies, one main highlight and one tiny sparkle in each eye, brows, cheeks, centered nose, face scale and monochrome ink weight.
Do not redesign, move or regenerate any component other than the Delighted mouth crop.
The mouth center must align with the V9 nose vertical centerline and the left/right black contour mass must be visually balanced at native 200x200.
mouth_contract: One compact rounded happy open smile, centered on the V9 nose axis, with mirrored left/right contour weight, a shallow lower curve, a small centered white opening and rounded ends. Target native 200x200 visible bounds approximately 24-28 pixels wide by 8-12 pixels high; no diagonal drift.

native_review_gate.symmetry: left/right visible black-pixel mass difference <= 2 pixels after center-axis alignment; mouth bbox center within 1 pixel of nose center
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject if the mouth looks slanted, offset, disconnected, over-wide, or heavier on one side
